label: 500 BCE
era_note: This is the axial plate. Confucius is teaching in Lu, the Buddha in Magadha, Mahavira among the same cities; the Second Temple is newly dedicated and the Gathas already old. Nearly everything on later plates descends from the handful of colors here, and nearly all the world is still outside them.
